_note: Every agency name in OPM's CURRENT PLUM export (tests/fixtures/opm/plum/escs_pbpub_download-data.csv, fetched 2026-09-21) that reached no organisation node in the curated graph when this pass began, with the live-row count measured from the export and the reviewed disposition of each. 96 agencies of the export's 174, carrying 1,301 of its 9,797 live rows. 'liveRows' counts Filled and Vacant rows before the fold on identical rows; Historical rows are never read. 'reachesNodeNow' is measured against the curated file as it stands after this pass, so a node_added row whose name the export spells differently reads false and says so in its note. Nothing here is a claim about a position: this file records which units the export names that the graph did not. CURATION.md §17 carries the reasoning; the alias candidates are handed off in data/audit/plum_alias_candidates_2026-09-21.md.

agencies.agency: OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF WAR
agencies.agencyPlain: OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF WAR
agencies.canonicalKey: office of the secretary of war
agencies.note: 506 live rows, the largest block, and nothing is added. Two independent reasons, either sufficient. FIRST, the bucket is not a unit: beneath it the export files not only the offices of the Under and Assistant Secretaries, CAPE, the Department CIO, Administration and Management and Washington Headquarters Services -- which are the Office of the Secretary -- but also the Defense Finance and Accounting Service (20 rows), the Defense Health Agency (12), the Defense Commissary Agency (5), DARPA (3), the Department of War Education Activity (6), the National Guard Bureau (4), the Office of the Joint Chiefs of Staff (8) and the United States Court of Appeals for the Armed Forces (7). The graph already carries those under Defense Agencies & Field Activities, the Joint Chiefs of Staff and the judiciary. Attaching 506 rows to one OSD node would file a DARPA director, a commissary chief executive and an Article I appellate judge inside the Secretary's immediate office. SECOND, no licence reaches it: the Government Manual's 2025-12-31 edition has no Office of the Secretary entry among its 231 entities, the Monthly Treasury Statement's only 'Office of the Secretary' line sits under the Department of Transportation, and www.defense.gov, dod.defense.gov and www.war.gov all answer robots.txt with 403 and are refused by this project's policy, so no page can be read. CURATION.md §17.1 carries the naming evidence.
